title: Te Mana Whakahē
intro: I ngā whenua onamata, i mua he mana nui i pupuri i te mana, i whakahaere i ngā rauemi nunui me te oranga o te tini o te tangata. Ahakoa ngā tohu me ngā whakatūpato mārama, i whiriwhiria e tēnei rangatira te ara whakakeke, ā, ka arahina atu ki tētahi pakanga nui ka pāorooro i roto i ngā wā.
clues: I kī ahau i a au te mana me te mana mutunga kore i runga i tētahi rohe nui whakaharahara.
I wero ahau i tētahi karere whakaiti i tonoa mai e te Ariki o ngā ao katoa.
I mōhiotia tōku iwi mō tō rātou mōhio ki ngā hanganga nunui me te awa i ora ai tō mātou ao.
I kite ahau i ngā tohu whakamiharo maha, tae atu ki tētahi tokotoko e huri ana hei nakahi, me tētahi ringa e kanapa ana.
I whakakahore ahau ki te tuku i tētahi rōpū pononga kia wehe i tōku whenua, ahakoa ngā whakahau a te Atua.
Nā taku whai i te iwi e wehe atu ana mātou ko aku ope taua i ārahi ki waenganui o te moana wehewehe.

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
